description: [roadmap S3.7, settles U-1069's cursor and tooltip parts] drawCursor composites a cursor image into g_blitSaveBuf only when the window under the cursor has an image at +0x208, and the only writers of +0x208 are View_ctor (0) and EditBox_setCursorChar (the text caret of an EditBox), so the image cursor exists only over an EditBox; every other window takes the Windows cursor (SetCursor / LoadCursorA), which a back-buffer frame never holds. drawTooltip draws g_tipText, written only by Tooltip::show / Tooltip::hide (the window tree's HotList tips). The port draws neither: no pinned in-game checkpoint shows either (the census residuals of log/roadmap/S3/7_notes.md section 5 are all attributed to other steps). Whether g_blitSaveBuf is the surface Display::present shows (U-1069's first part) stays not determined: no ported frame draws into it.
needed: A recording with the cursor over an EditBox (the character editor's bio field, cov_r_bio) or a widget HotList tip on screen at a checkpoint.

description: [roadmap S3.7] The run palette's entries: drawTextRun takes a colour without bit 31 as an index into the palette of g_engine83ad18 + 4, else the surface's own, else g_engine83ad0c + 4 (c3et.cpp AllocTextBuffer_re). Only entry 1 is known (U-1230's measured RGB (0x80, 0, 0)); another index is reported. No pinned frame of this step draws a shadowed message text: drawWindow's and the tips' texts take drawTextSurface's shadow only for a line height above 16 (H = Widget_value - 4), which g_font51b360 and g_fontRef_519fd8 do not reach in the frames judged; the emulator oracle checks the mechanism with a fake palette, not the colours.
needed: A frame with a shadowed message text, or the Palette objects read at a checkpoint (scenario_ab.py --extra-regions).

description: [roadmap S3.7] The original keeps ONE measure state (drawMarkupRun's style +0x38 and dropdown +0x4c) in the root Image for the layout's Text_put calls (wrapMessageBuffer, commands.cpp, measured by gditext over the Image in memory) and the drawing's (drawMessageBuffer's per-character Text_put); the port's drawing keeps its own copy in the text family. They agree while every text closes its styles; a text left inside a style ({ without }) carries the style into the next measure in the original's one state. No pinned text was seen to leave a style open.
needed: A text with an unclosed style in a pinned frame.

description: [roadmap S3.7] drawRichText counts every link token ($ + the 6-byte token of f_strpool_4e4218 + 0x3c) in the Image's +0xb0 and shows a MessageBoxA (strings f_strpool_4e4218 + 0x44 / + 0x68) once the count passes 0x28; nothing in drawRichText resets the count. The port does not count links and shows no message box (9 of the oracle's 400 constructed cases reach the box in the original: drawMessageBuffer redraws a line with links once per pass). No pinned text holds a link token.
needed: A frame-code text with link tokens (the tutorial / help texts) drawn often enough in one run, measured on the original.

description: [roadmap S3.7] drawWindow centres a golfer / picture window's text by h = 15 r + 0x20 of its wrap (r = wrapMessageBuffer's line count) when h < 0x60; the port's callers pass h (commands.cpp draw_window_effect, 7_merge.md edit 4); tick_leaves.inc's registered drawWindow (the location screen, the browsers: sel -1) passes only H = g_value587ea0, so a golfer window reached through it with H == 0x60 is reported (h not known), not drawn. No pinned checkpoint reaches it.
needed: A caller of the registered drawWindow with a golfer selection.

description: [roadmap S3.7] Text_put is a frame-code drop (tick.cpp kDrops) whose result the frame code uses for drawing only (P4's ball / golfer labels: the drawMapLine bar ends and the thought box's position); with a backend attached the text family now hands the width back (7_merge.md edit 7: gfx_take_value), without one the frame keeps 0 as before. The thought box it places is judged (cov_a_flags end equals the reference; control 5 RED); the bars are S3.8's line passes and wait for that body.
needed: S3.8's drawMapLine body, then the labels' bars compared with the references.

description: [roadmap S3.7] drawRichText's dropdown (`^` while +0x50 is 1) builds a combo from the g_richTextPairs slot of the digit after the dropdown token, and RichTail draws the arrow image +0x54; the root Image's +0x54 is 0 (Image_ctor) and the slots are 0 in every pinned image, so the port draws no combo and reports a filled slot. Only the window tree's widgets (TextView) set either.
needed: A frame-code text with a dropdown token over a filled slot.

description: [roadmap S3.7] The hover tips' and thought labels' dark bars are drawMapLine (Terrain::drawLine, an OpenGL line in the terrain view): S3.8's line passes. The text family calls the body by name when the tree holds one and otherwise reports `no body: drawMapLine` as the frame code does; the tips' texts are judged without their bars (the opaque measure leaves the missing bar's pixels out).
